_comment: Every usage event the app may send. The server rejects anything not listed here, and the app's typed Events API is generated from this file (frontend: generateTelemetryEvents). Adding or changing an event is a reviewed change: props are enums, bools or bounded ints, never free text, ids, titles, queries or anything else that identifies a person or what they read. See docs/observability.md.

events.name: app_opened
events.description: The app started (once per launch, after consent is known).

events.name: search
events.description: A catalogue search finished. Never the query.

events.name: book_opened
events.description: The reader opened an edition. Never which one.

events.name: upload_finished
events.description: An upload ended (not when the reader cancelled it).

events.name: recommendation_opened
events.description: A For You suggestion was opened.

events.name: recommendation_saved
events.description: A For You suggestion was added to Want to read.

events.name: recommendation_dismissed
events.description: A For You suggestion was dismissed.

events.name: went_offline
events.description: The app lost the server (a request got no answer).
